- <a id="inv-access.branch_control_enforced"></a>**`access.branch_control_enforced`** · access — Writing to a branch without permission is refused on every path, including dolt_merge, dolt_reset, cherry-pick and revert.
- <a id="inv-access.denied_no_effect"></a>**`access.denied_no_effect`** · access — A statement refused for privileges changes nothing and reports the refusal.
- <a id="inv-access.history_respects_grants"></a>**`access.history_respects_grants`** · access — History, diff, blame and AS OF never expose rows of a table the role cannot read.
- <a id="inv-access.least_privilege"></a>**`access.least_privilege`** · access — A role reads and writes only what it was granted, and REVOKE takes effect for new statements.
